5.text:
But the real prize is the conciliatory
faction. We must share intelligence on
the Purgers with the Farlands too.

Suspicion and fear will be our
greatest enemy. May I ask you to
prevent them from taking hold?

Even so, with you, I believe we can
walk the right path.

We'll join hands with the knightly
houses, quell this chaos, and find the
truth. Lend me your strength, Swes.

I was working hard, too! In the
Farlands! Very hard!!

I reassured the Swes folk worried
about Yuwel's moves! I helped
with a mountain of cleanup!!

And yet! Everyone only fusses over
Prince Varen and Yuwel!! They could
praise me a little, couldn't they!

I-it's not like nobody praised you,
right? Yuwel and the others were very
grateful.

Well, you did show plenty of spirit.
You didn't run when we met monsters.

Heh, heh. Indeed, indeed! After
all, I was entrusted by Dul Kugala.
I'm still working hard, you see!!

By the way, that outfit is from
White Fest, isn't it? Is it for work?

Yes, there's a merchants'
exchange tonight. I'm returning
to what I should really be doing.

To share intel with the Farlands'
peace faction, stop suspicion and fear
from spreading, and find who to trust.

Though my legs still shake at the
responsibility and trust.

What, need another kick in the rear
before you step forward?

Heh... don't
underestimate me, Nimbus.

Scary things are scary! If you think
I can charge ahead alone, you've
wronged me!!

Just go do what you gotta do.
I'll laugh if you trip.
...Yes! Today too, I'll do all I can!

What an honor to meet you. Your
brother has been a great help to me.

The Yuni you introduced the other day
is selling well. I've even decided to
stock other sparkling wines.

You flatter me. I've been enjoying
Palpebra's wine lately. The grapes'
sweetness is so vivid—

I'm glad I held this party. They
seem to be enjoying themselves.

It's thanks to the connection
Libram made for us. That 'matter'
looks set to go smoothly, too.

Valentine's Day and White Day.
We hope to establish those
customs in the Farlands.

We'd very much like Palpebra's and
Shibuya's people to lend us their
knowledge.

This is my friend from Shibuya.
They plan to open a sweets shop in
Palpebra soon.

In time, I hope they'll expand into
the Farlands too. Shibuya's sweets
are wonderful.

...Honestly, I'm moved. I thought,
presumptuously, that the Farlands
didn't take in other cultures.

I can't say that's untrue.
Many of our people take great
pride in our own culture.

But I want to take in new things, too.
To evolve culture and commerce. There
are people who wish for that as well.

Connecting those wishes is my work
now. Please rely on me anytime.

...You've met good people,
Libram.

Next year, the Farlands will
be lively, brother. I plan to
prepare as soon as possible.

I found someone I can discuss the
Purger matter with. I'll introduce
you later.

...I've also chosen who from House
Swes will help control the
information. Let's meet soon.

...We're finally face to face, yet
we've had no time for a proper talk
since the monster disaster, have we?

Ha ha... Truly. I hope the day comes
when the three of us brothers can
talk, just us.
...How is Brother Ziggurat?

He stubbornly avoids me. He's surely
still moving behind the scenes.

...For now, sharing intelligence with
those of like mind comes first. Facing
Ziggurat may have to wait a little.

The right path is a plodding one,
after all. ...It's frustrating.
It's all right, brother.

I believe in the path we
want to take. Because—!

—See?
We met.
It's been a while, Brother Ziggurat.

...Why are you here? Did Azrail put
you up to this? Or else—

Of course not! It's for
reconciliation, obviously!

I gave it everything. I asked around
through every connection I had, and
finally found you...!

I have mountains of questions! About
Kwetur, too! Why are you with Brother
Azrail—!

The three of us brothers, joining
hands. Is that really so hard...?

...Truly. Weak, soft,
with unsteady eyes. Why
have you come this far...
Brother, I—

I will never accept Azrail's path. I
expect nothing from an eldest son who
grovels to other countries.

I will bring the Farlands the
greatest profit. I'll prove it.

Then we'll certainly meet again.
When our paths cross...!

Huh, Libby? What are you doing,
standing around alone?

S-standing around, you say!
I was desperately holding on!

My knees were shaking the whole time!
If anything, I deserve praise!!

Yeah, yeah.
Libby's amazing, we know.

Exactly! I'm amazing and admirable!
Though I feel there was more we could
have talked about—

I can't assume everything will
succeed. Just having a conversation
is a step forward...! That is my way!

No idea what you're on about.
If you're free, let's go drink.
I wanna land a pickup too.

Again!? Stop using
only my good looks!!?

...It's all right. Even if I trip
shamefully or sulk, I have friends
who'll laugh about it—

That alone lets me
move forward again...!
